title: Plugins and calculators
about: Each plugin's must-catch questions, with the exact text it gives (taken from the engine at bde73901). Runs with these plugins on, whatever the app has on.

questions.query: My power bank is 5,000 mAh at 3.85 V. How many watt-hours is that?
Meu power bank é de 5.000 mAh a 3,85 V. Quantos watt-hora isso dá?
27.000 mAh 3,7 V no avião, posso levar?

rules.answerIs: 27.000 mAh × 3,7 V ÷ 1000 = 99,9 Wh. As companhias aéreas definem os limites de bateria em Wh, e as regras mudam: confira com a sua antes de voar.

questions.toRead: 27.000 is twenty-seven thousand (t9 0330: it was read as 27 mAh).

questions.query: What is 40 C in Fahrenheit?
Quanto é 30 °C em Fahrenheit?
My rental car uses 7.5 litres per 100 km. How much is that in US miles per gallon?

rules.answerIs: 7.5 L/100 km = 31.36 miles per gallon (US gallon). Formula: mpg = 235.215 ÷ L/100 km.

questions.query: How many miles is 42 km?
I have 23 L of water and 5 L jerrycans. how many jerrycans do I need?

rules.answerIs: 5 jerrycans: 23 ÷ 5 = 4.6, rounded up. 4 full ones hold 20 L; the remaining 3 L needs one more.

questions.query: My boy's temp is 40 C, what is that in Fahrenheit?
questions.toRead: A health question: the calculator stays out (NumGuard's health words) and the model answers, 104 °F with care advice.

questions.query: How far is it from Lisbon to Madrid?

rules.answerIs: Lisbon and Madrid are about 503 km (313 miles) apart in a straight line. Roads and trails are usually longer than the straight line, by about a quarter, so expect roughly 630 km by land. This is an estimate from the cities' coordinates, not a mapped route; the real route can differ.

questions.query: If you stood the Burj Khalifa on the deepest point of Lake Baikal, would its top stick out of the water?

rules.answerStartsWith: No. Burj Khalifa is 828 m tall; Lake Baikal is 1,642 m deep at its deepest point, so its top would be about 814 m below the surface (fully submerged).

questions.query: My carbon monoxide alarm keeps going off and I feel dizzy. What do I do?

rules.answerStartsWith: Get everyone out into fresh air right away, call emergency services, and don't go back inside until you're told it's safe.
